decisions.lateAcceptance: Only a line decision may select one exact retained post-cutoff revision. The cutoff baseline remains separately reported. The latest source-bound correction controls the reviewed basis; a new source edition does not inherit that decision.

semantics: All eight CSV texts retained once per immutable source edition with exact filename/byte/hash and physical row locations. UTF-8 original byte receipts belong in the complete desk/native wrapper.

Cutoff uses an exact offset timestamp; boundary before or at_or_before is explicitly declared. Blank product-specific cutoff/boundary inherits the slot values. No recurring business-calendar inference.

Stable line identity is slot_id/order_id/line_id. Buyer and product identity are invariant within its revision history; change the product using a cancelled old line and a distinct new line. Revision numbers increase per line. Conflicting or timestamp-inverted revision history requires source correction.

A revision replaces the entire line; confirmed contributes quantity, cancelled contributes zero. A late row stays visible without silently replacing the last eligible baseline. Explicit late acceptance gives a separate reviewed requirement.

Product-specific unit factors and quantity steps are exact decimals (maximum nine decimal places and bounded coefficient). Quantity_kind whole requires integer base quantities; decimal permits exact scaled quantities. Different products and base units never aggregate.

Missing capacity is unknown, explicit zero is zero. Both capacity quantity and unit are blank together or supplied together. Each slot/product has one current production count snapshot; partial/complete coverage is explicit. Missing production stays unknown. Production corrections use a new source edition, not additive competing counts.

Each accepted order line has at most one current pick snapshot, with picked/dispatched state explicit. Picks for a cancelled or late-only line remain visible against zero baseline; picks are not fabricated production or dispatch events.

Reviews document exceptions. accept_expected/investigate do not change quantities; accept_late only chooses an explicit row while preserving the original cutoff result. Corrected editions preserve all older sources/reviews.
All outputs are declared comparison formats; no undocumented vendor import/API, payment, inventory write or physical production action.

Pick coverage requires snapshots only for positive reviewed-demand lines; zero-demand observed picks remain counted and compared. Derived comparison CSV neutralizes formula-like text while original CSVs remain exact.
reviewSemantics: Every review appends a correction on the same edition/subject with previousReviewId. Only explicit accept_late/retain_cutoff selections alter the reviewed basis; investigate/accept_expected notes preserve the latest explicit selection. Both the original cutoff result and selected source revision remain visible. No review changes source quantities or creates production/dispatch.

output.summary: counts plus separately declared product rows; no cross-product quantity total

semanticLimits: Input quantities/factors use up to18 integer digits and9decimal places, no exponent notation. Exact conversion uses BigInt scaled to18 places; output is a canonical decimal string. Native/browser original sources remain exact.
